 Order

The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeks extension of interim bail granted to the applicant by this Court vide order dated 05.01.2023, in case FIR No. 512/2022 under Sections 307/498A/34 IPC, registered at P.S. Ranhola.
The present applicant was granted interim bail vide order dated 05.01.2023 for a period of two weeks as expected date of delivery of the applicant's wife was stated to be 09.01.2023.
Vide the present application, the applicant seeks further extension of the interim bail on the ground that now the expected date of delivery of his wife is 21.01.2023.

Learned APP for the State, on instructions from the Investigating Officer, states that the medical documents annexed with the present application have been verified and confirms that the expected date of delivery of the applicant's wife is now 21.01.2023.

In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim bail granted to the present applicant vide order dated 05.01.2023 is extended on the same terms and conditions for a period of twenty days from today.
The present application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
Order be uploaded on the website of this court forthwith.
